list.name: run_id
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "manufacturing", tag: "run_id", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "line_metrics" and r.scenario == ${scenario:doublequote})

list.name: station
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "manufacturing", tag: "station", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "station_metrics" and r.scenario == ${scenario:doublequote})

targets.query:
from(bucket: "manufacturing")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "station_metrics" and r.scenario == ${scenario:doublequote} and r.run_id == ${run_id:doublequote} and r._field == "state")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.station =~ /${station:regex}/)
  |> drop(columns: ["scenario", "run_id"])

from(bucket: "manufacturing")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "line_metrics" and r.scenario == ${scenario:doublequote} and r.run_id == ${run_id:doublequote} and r._field == "oee")
  |> drop(columns: ["scenario", "run_id"])

from(bucket: "manufacturing")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "line_metrics" and r.scenario == ${scenario:doublequote} and r.run_id == ${run_id:doublequote} and r._field == "throughput")
  |> drop(columns: ["scenario", "run_id"])

from(bucket: "manufacturing")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "line_metrics" and r.scenario == ${scenario:doublequote} and r.run_id == ${run_id:doublequote})
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "total_wip" or r._field == "total_good" or r._field == "total_scrap")
  |> drop(columns: ["scenario", "run_id"])
